name: Keyideas Jewelry Customizer – Diamond Ring Builder & Engagement Rings for WooCommerce
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Keyideas Jewelry Customizer is the WooCommerce ring builder focused on selling more engagement rings and diamonds.

Increase conversions and grow your average order value with a 3-step ring builder. Shoppers select a diamond or gemstone, pair it with one of your ring settings, pick their ring size and add the finished ring to the cart, with the price and the ring summary updating at every step.

Keyideas Jewelry Customizer is designed to get your jewelry store selling custom rings in minutes: activate it, choose the stones you offer and your ring collection, and the diamond listing, detail and review pages are created for you.

Integrates with WooCommerce, so rings and loose stones are added to the WooCommerce cart and paid for through your usual WooCommerce checkout, with every order showing the stone’s stock number and the ring setting.

You can also use it to set up a diamond and engagement ring store with any WordPress theme, fast and easy.

Free Demo | Compare Free vs Pro | Documentation

Sell More Engagement Rings And Boost Your Revenue

Give shoppers the guided, made-to-order experience of a jewelry showroom, where every customer designs a ring of their own and spends more on it. This is ideal for:
* Jewelry Stores
* Engagement Ring Shops
* Custom Ring Makers and Jewelry Designers
* Brick-and-Mortar Jewelers Moving Online

Offer Thousands Of Diamonds Without Holding Stock

Keep your focus on selling while the ring builder shows natural, lab-grown and colored diamonds and gemstones next to your ring settings, with your own margins and discounts. This is ideal for:
* Diamond and Gemstone Retailers
* Lab-Grown Diamond Stores
* Stores Selling Loose Stones and Complete Rings
* Stores Without Their Own Diamond Inventory

Sell Your Own Inventory Alongside The Vendor Feed

Already have stones in your safe? Import them with a CSV file and sell them in the same ring builder, managed from the Feed Center with your own margins, discounts and sales dashboard. This is ideal for:
* Jewelers With Their Own Diamond Stock
* Wholesalers and Manufacturers Selling Direct to Consumers
* Multi-Supplier Diamond Stores
* Jewelers Importing Stones by CSV

Shortcodes for Diamond Listings, Diamond Details, Ring Review and the Ring Builder Bar

The plugin creates its pages for you when it is activated. You can also use the following shortcodes on your own pages:

  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-Listing category=”NATURAL”] – adds a diamond listing with search and filters; use NATURAL, LAB CREATED, GEMSTONE or COLORED DIAMONDS as the category
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-DetailPage] – the diamond detail page, with 360° view, certificate and the Add to Ring and Add to Cart buttons
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-BYORPage] – the ring review page, where shoppers see the stone and setting together, pick a ring size and add the ring to the cart
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-BYORStrip] – the 3-step Build Your Own Ring bar, showing the shopper’s progress
  • [KIRB-RingBuilder-SettingButton] – the “Choose This Setting” button for a ring setting product

Ring Builder Modules:

Build Your Own Ring

Shoppers start with a stone or with a setting, and the ring builder walks them through the rest.

Build Your Own Ring offers you options to:

  • start with a natural, lab-grown or colored diamond, or a gemstone
  • start with a ring setting from your WooCommerce ring collection
  • see the stone and the setting together on the review page, with the total price
  • pick a ring size from your region’s ring size standard
  • buy loose stones on their own

Diamond Search and Filters

Ten popular shapes and filters for carat, color, clarity, cut, polish, symmetry, fluorescence, price and certificate lab, with sorting and a grid or list view. Shoppers can compare stones and come back to the ones they recently viewed.

Diamond Detail Pages

Every stone has its own page with a 360° view, the grading certificate, a virtual diamond viewer that shows the stone on a hand, and easy guides to carat, cut, color and clarity.

Feed Center

Manage your stones from one place, in a Feed Center that opens in a new tab, already signed in to your store. Set margins by price or carat, add discounts and choose which inventory is live.

Import Your Own Stones

Upload your own diamonds and gemstones with a CSV file, using the natural, lab-grown, colored diamond and gemstone templates. The free version shows 30% of the stones you import; Pro shows all of them.

Sales Dashboard

See the stones you sold, revenue, profit and monthly trends. Paid orders with ring builder stones show up automatically.

Appearance

Set your primary and accent brand colors and the heading and subheading typography: font, desktop and mobile sizes, weight, line height, letter spacing and color.

Use Preview in New Tab to see your unsaved changes on the storefront first. Only you see them until you click Save Appearance.

Language & Region

Show the storefront in English (US), English (UK), French, German, Italian or Spanish, and choose the default language. Pick your region’s ring size standard or edit the list of sizes.

Every storefront text can be translated or reworded: download a CSV, edit the Translation column and upload it again.

WooCommerce Integration

Keyideas Jewelry Customizer integrates beautifully with WooCommerce, allowing you to do the following out of the box:

  • Sell Complete Rings – the stone and the setting chosen in the ring builder are added to the WooCommerce cart together, with the ring size
  • Sell Loose Stones – diamonds and gemstones can be bought on their own, without a setting
  • Use Your Own Ring Settings – any WooCommerce product category becomes your ring collection
  • Know What to Order – each WooCommerce order shows the stone’s stock number and, for rings, the setting, and paid orders show up in the Sales dashboard

Others

  • “Start with a Natural Diamond”, “Start with a Lab Diamond”, “Start with a Gemstone”, “Start with a Colored Diamond” and “Start with a Setting” page links for your menus
  • drop a hint, share a stone and ask an expert on the detail and review pages (see the demo)
  • default sort order and the number of stones per listing page
  • noindex, nofollow on diamond products, their categories and the ring builder pages, so your own pages stay first in search results
  • server cache for faster listing pages, with a Clear Cache button
  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible
  • mobile-ready storefront and admin dashboard

Powerful Add-ons

Keyideas Jewelry Customizer has a range of premium features and Add-ons that extend the power of the ring builder:

Pro Features (available in the RingBuilder Pro version, plans from $145 per month)

  • Live Inventory – around 200,000 to 400,000 real natural, lab-grown and colored diamonds and gemstones from trusted vendors, with prices and stock kept up to date (Nivoda comes pre-integrated)
  • All Your Imported Stones – every stone you import via CSV is shown, not just 30%
  • AI Shopping Assistant – helps shoppers find the right diamond on the listing page
  • Online Ring Sizer – shoppers find their ring size at home
  • Appearance Editor – layout styles for the ring builder bar, filters, listing, gallery and review pages, plus custom CSS
  • Wishlist – shoppers save their favourite stones and rings to come back later
  • Add to Cart on Ring Settings – customers buy a ring setting directly from its product page
  • Choose This Setting Button Control – show or hide the button on engagement ring pages
  • Disable Build Your Own Ring – sell loose stones only
  • Done-for-you Setup – our team installs, configures and tests the ring builder with your theme in 3-5 business days

Paid Add-ons (available for the Free and Pro versions)

  • Pendant Builder – customers pair a diamond or gemstone with a pendant setting, in the same steps as the ring builder
  • Earring Builder – customers choose a matched pair of stones and an earring setting
  • Product Library – 100+ trending engagement and wedding ring designs with lifestyle 360° videos
  • Redact Diamond Certificate – mask certificate numbers in the PDF certificates shoppers see
  • Custom Supplier Integration – connect RapNet, VDB or any other diamond supplier via CSV or API
  • No-BGM & Eye-Clean Nivoda Diamonds – show only stones with no brown, green or milky tints and eye-clean clarity
  • Jewelry Website Design – complete jewelry website design and customization by our team

The Complete Jewelry Store Toolkit

Combine the ring builder with our other jewelry apps to give shoppers the full luxury store experience.

Pair Keyideas Jewelry Customizer with Keyideas Jewelry Filter and Search for fast filters across every jewelry type, Vizora – 3D Try-On for trying rings on with augmented reality, Jewelith – 3D Design Studio for real-time 3D jewelry configuration, and Timenox for adding luxury watches to your store.

Keyideas Jewelry Customizer in your Language

The ring builder storefront is ready in English (US), English (UK), French, German, Italian and Spanish, and the plugin dashboard is translated into Italian. We would love help with more languages, so please join us at translate.wordpress.org.
You can also change any storefront text from Appearance → Language & Region, by downloading and uploading a CSV.
For more information please visit our documentation page

Website

https://apps.keyideasinfotech.com/pages/jewelry-customizer

Documentation

https://apps.keyideasinfotech.com/pages/ring-builder/

Addons

https://apps.keyideasinfotech.com/pages/ring-builder/

External Services

This plugin connects to the following services. No data is sent until the plugin is activated and set up by a site administrator.

Keyideas RingBuilder API (https://engagement-ring-builder-o4hk8.kinsta.app)
Provides the diamond and gemstone inventory, prices, product details and recommendations shown in the ring builder until the store is connected to the Keyideas RingBuilder app (see below), and the sold-out updates.
* On registration/activation: the store email address, admin email address, store currency, site domain and the contact details entered in the activation form (name, company, email, phone, country) are sent to create the store account.
* On every listing or detail page load (when not cached): the selected filters, currency and product IDs are sent to fetch inventory.
* When a ring is built, added to cart or ordered: the diamond ID, event type and a session ID are sent for usage statistics.
* When the plugin is uninstalled: the store owner name, company name and email are sent so Keyideas is notified of the uninstall.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas RingBuilder app and Feed Center (https://ring-builder.apps.keyideasglobal.com)
Once the store is connected, provides the diamond and gemstone inventory, prices, product details and recommendations shown in the ring builder: on every listing or detail page load (when not cached), the shop name, store token, selected filters, currency and product IDs are sent to fetch inventory.
* When an order with a ring builder stone is paid: the shop name, the stones’ stock numbers, the order item IDs and the WooCommerce product IDs are sent, so the sale shows in the Feed Center’s Sales dashboard.
The Feed Center link in the plugin dashboard opens the Keyideas RingBuilder app’s Feed Center in a new browser tab, signed in to your store. The plugin connects your store to the app on its own; no sign-up form is shown.
* To connect the store (after activation, when an administrator opens the dashboard or the Feed Center, until the store is connected): the site URL, the site name, the administrator email address and country from the activation form, the store currency and the plugin version are sent. The first time, the app creates the store’s account with them.
* With that request, until the store has its admin key: a random one-time code is sent to get the key, which signs the sign-in token. The app sends the key, with that code, to this site’s REST route /kirb/v1/admin-secret, which only keeps a key that comes with the code it issued.
* When the administrator opens the Feed Center: the shop name and a short-lived signed sign-in token are sent in the Feed Center link.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas demo product server (https://keyideasglobal.com)
Only used to import demo ring setting products. A request is made to download the demo product list and images; no site data is sent.
Terms, Privacy Policy.

geoPlugin (http://www.geoplugin.net)
Used on the plugin activation form in the admin dashboard to pre-select the administrator’s country. The administrator’s IP address is sent when the activation form is displayed.
Terms and Privacy Policy.

Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com)
The Poppins and Assistant fonts are loaded from Google Fonts on the ring builder pages, and so are the heading fonts chosen in Appearance → Typography (only when one is chosen; the default inherits the theme’s font). Google receives the visitor’s IP address and browser information.
Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Brevo Meetings (https://meet.brevo.com)
The plugin dashboard (activation form, Premium Features and Contact Us) links to a Brevo booking page for a free consultation. Nothing is sent unless the administrator clicks the link and books a meeting.
Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas forms service (https://apps-manager.apps.keyideasglobal.com)
Renders the Contact Us form in the plugin dashboard and the optional feedback form shown when the plugin is deactivated.
* Contact Us: the details the administrator enters are sent when they submit the form.
* Deactivation feedback: the form is only loaded when the administrator clicks “Deactivate” for this plugin. Only if they submit it, the chosen reason, any text they type, the administrator’s email address and the site URL are sent. “Skip & deactivate” sends nothing.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.0 or higher, then upload the diamond-ring-builder-jewelry folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory (or install it from Plugins → Add New)
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open Keyideas Jewelry Customizer in the admin menu and follow the Setup Guide: choose your stones and ring collection in Settings, your colors and languages in Appearance, and your margins in the Feed Center. Add the “Start with…” page links to your menu and you’re done!
sections.faq:
What type of jewelry stores can I create?

Here are some examples of what you can sell with the ring builder: engagement rings, loose natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, colored diamonds and gemstones. Stores using it include dimendscaasi.com, bongioielli.com and ramziandco.com.au.

What is the difference between the free and Pro versions?

The free version includes the complete 3-step ring builder, Add to Cart with WooCommerce checkout, the Feed Center, CSV import (30% of imported stones shown), the sales dashboard, Appearance and Language & Region, with a sample set of stones.

Pro adds live inventory of around 200,000 to 400,000 real stones, shows all your imported stones, and adds the AI shopping assistant, the online ring sizer, the appearance editor, store-wide options and done-for-you setup. Compare Free vs Pro

Can I import my own diamonds and gemstones?

Yes, upload a CSV file in the Feed Center. The free version shows 30% of the stones you import; Pro shows all of them. Start from a template: natural.csv, lab.csv, colored.csv, gemstones.csv.

Where do the ring settings come from?

From your own WooCommerce products. In Settings → Display Diamonds & Gemstones → Select Ring Collection, choose the product category that holds your ring settings, or create one.

Need designs? The Product Library add-on offers 100+ engagement and wedding ring designs with 360° videos (digital assets only; manufacturing and fulfillment stay with you).

Can I match the ring builder to my brand?

Yes, in Appearance you set your primary and accent colors and the heading and subheading fonts, then click Preview in New Tab to see the storefront with your unsaved changes. Pro adds layout styles and custom CSS.

Can I change the storefront language and text?

Yes, the storefront can be shown in English (US), English (UK), French, German, Italian or Spanish. In Appearance → Language & Region, turn on your languages and set the default one. To change any text, click Download next to a language, edit the Translation column of the CSV, Upload it and save Appearance.

How do I set ring sizes for my region?

In Appearance → Language & Region → Select Ring Size, choose your region’s standard (for example United States–Mexico–Canada). Click Edit to add or remove sizes, separated by commas.

How do I order a diamond a customer bought?

Each WooCommerce order shows the stock number of the stone, and the ring setting for rings built in the ring builder. For Nivoda stones, order from Nivoda with that stock number (a Nivoda account is needed). RapNet, VDB and other suppliers can be connected with the Custom Supplier Integration add-on.

Will thousands of diamond products hurt my SEO?

No, diamond products, their categories and the ring builder pages are marked noindex, nofollow automatically. If another SEO plugin such as Yoast or Rank Math still lists them, set the kirb-* diamond product categories to noindex and leave them out of its sitemap.

The diamond or ring pages show “page not found”. What do I do?

Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save Changes. If the ring builder still does not look right with your theme, contact us from Contact Us in the plugin and our team will help with theme-specific adjustments.

How much does Pro cost? Do you offer refunds?

Plans start at $145 per month, with a one-time setup fee of $550-$1,000 depending on your store. Because setup includes server, account and feed configuration, we do not offer refunds after payment, so please try the free version first. See plans and pricing

Where can I find out more information?

For more information please check out the Keyideas Jewelry Customizer documentation and the video tutorials. For help, use Contact Us in the plugin, book a free consultation or email sales@keyideasinfotech.com.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Keyideas Jewelry Customizer plugin by email to sales@keyideasinfotech.com with the subject “Security”, and not in the public support forum. Our team will verify the report and release a fix.

* On registration/activation: the store email address, admin email address, store currency, site domain and the contact details entered in the activation form (name, company, email, phone, country) are sent to create the store account.
* On every listing or detail page load (when not cached): the selected filters, currency and product IDs are sent to fetch inventory.
* When a ring is built, added to cart or ordered: the diamond ID, event type and a session ID are sent for usage statistics.
* When the plugin is uninstalled: the store owner name, company name and email are sent so Keyideas is notified of the uninstall.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas RingBuilder app and Feed Center (https://ring-builder.apps.keyideasglobal.com)
Once the store is connected, provides the diamond and gemstone inventory, prices, product details and recommendations shown in the ring builder: on every listing or detail page load (when not cached), the shop name, store token, selected filters, currency and product IDs are sent to fetch inventory.
* When an order with a ring builder stone is paid: the shop name, the stones’ stock numbers, the order item IDs and the WooCommerce product IDs are sent, so the sale shows in the Feed Center’s Sales dashboard.
The Feed Center link in the plugin dashboard opens the Keyideas RingBuilder app’s Feed Center in a new browser tab, signed in to your store. The plugin connects your store to the app on its own; no sign-up form is shown.
* To connect the store (after activation, when an administrator opens the dashboard or the Feed Center, until the store is connected): the site URL, the site name, the administrator email address and country from the activation form, the store currency and the plugin version are sent. The first time, the app creates the store’s account with them.
* With that request, until the store has its admin key: a random one-time code is sent to get the key, which signs the sign-in token. The app sends the key, with that code, to this site’s REST route /kirb/v1/admin-secret, which only keeps a key that comes with the code it issued.
* When the administrator opens the Feed Center: the shop name and a short-lived signed sign-in token are sent in the Feed Center link.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas demo product server (https://keyideasglobal.com)
Only used to import demo ring setting products. A request is made to download the demo product list and images; no site data is sent.
Terms, Privacy Policy.

geoPlugin (http://www.geoplugin.net)
Used on the plugin activation form in the admin dashboard to pre-select the administrator’s country. The administrator’s IP address is sent when the activation form is displayed.
Terms and Privacy Policy.

Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com)
The Poppins and Assistant fonts are loaded from Google Fonts on the ring builder pages, and so are the heading fonts chosen in Appearance → Typography (only when one is chosen; the default inherits the theme’s font). Google receives the visitor’s IP address and browser information.
Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Brevo Meetings (https://meet.brevo.com)
The plugin dashboard (activation form, Premium Features and Contact Us) links to a Brevo booking page for a free consultation. Nothing is sent unless the administrator clicks the link and books a meeting.
Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.

Keyideas forms service (https://apps-manager.apps.keyideasglobal.com)
Renders the Contact Us form in the plugin dashboard and the optional feedback form shown when the plugin is deactivated.
* Contact Us: the details the administrator enters are sent when they submit the form.
* Deactivation feedback: the form is only loaded when the administrator clicks “Deactivate” for this plugin. Only if they submit it, the chosen reason, any text they type, the administrator’s email address and the site URL are sent. “Skip & deactivate” sends nothing.
Service provided by Keyideas Infotech Pvt. Ltd.: Terms, Privacy Policy.
